text:
The deploy is not confirmed healthy. Image `api:7f3c2e1` built, pushed, and was applied to `deployment/api` on staging, but `/healthz` still returned 503 when the 60s healthcheck timed out.

I haven't determined why. It could be a rollout still in progress, pods crash-looping on the new image, or the fix itself breaking startup. Staging may now be serving errors. `kubectl rollout status deployment/api` and the new pods' logs will show which. If the new image is at fault, `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api` reverts staging.
